dct_description_sm: Type: Abbreviations Notes: DTMGR = Deep Temporal Model Gesture Recognition - used as the abbreviated project name for file naming purposes.

This is a pre-processed version of a publicly available dataset used for human gesture recognition application. Our method won the first prize in the Chalearn Looking at People (2014) challenge and we are sharing our implementation that makes use of this pre-processed data.

The DeepGestures application code can be downloaded from DeepGestures Lasagne
